Gunbarrel.notes: Signature bump run: Face+Gunbarrel line is ~1,600 vertical ft to California Lodge; 'VW-sized' moguls; steepest 136 ft measured at 31.6 deg (~62% grade) which matches the terrain-tile max-50 m value of 62%. Trees flanking the run offer a bail-out; Round-a-Bout crosses it.
Gunbarrel.source: skiheavenly.com mountain-info ('over 1,600 vertical feet of bumps'); visitlaketahoe.com 9-iconic-trails; dcski.com/forum/37293 (Google Earth pitch survey); xpatmatt Heavenly Micro Guide; donsnotes.com/sports/ski_gunbarrel.html

The Face.notes: Double-black mogul run under the Tram, 'unforgiving in its steepness', feeds Gunbarrel/East Bowl. Groomed occasionally (lower part groomed Mar 2019). Terrain tiles give 50% sustained, below Gunbarrel; the OSM line may not follow the steepest fall line.
The Face.source: Heavenly trail map text quoted by onthesnow; skiheavenly experience checklist; firsttracksonline 2019-03 report

East Bowl.notes: Double-black bump bowl skier's left of Gunbarrel; the escape from Gunbarrel bumps per Don's Notes.

East Bowl Woods.notes: Steep trees skier's left of Gunbarrel; ~33 deg sustained per terrain tiles, thin early-season cover.
East Bowl Woods.source: OSM gladed; terrain tiles; firsttracksonline 2008 (2 in cover in trees left of The Face)

Hogsback.notes: Rocky ridge run above West Bowl on the California side; 'always rocky'; needs a deep base. 468 m vertical.
Hogsback.source: firsttracksonline 2008-01 MLK report; worldsnowboardguide (powder-day pick); terrain tiles

West Bowl.notes: California-side black bowl beside Pistol/Hogsback; needs snow.

Pistol.notes: California-side black near Gunbarrel Express / West Bowl (NOT a Mott Canyon chute - OSM centroid is 250 m from Gunbarrel Express). Shaded left side holds winter snow.
Pistol.source: OSM geometry; firsttracksonline 2019-03 ('The Pistol ... shaded left side')

Advanced Round-a-Bout.notes: Gladed short-cut off Round-a-Bout between The Face and Groove.

Round-a-Bout.notes: 3.7 km road that bails intermediates around The Face and Gunbarrel from the Tram/Gondola ridge to California Lodge; a few steeper rollers (26% max).

Easy Street.notes: Wide green beside the Big Easy chair at the top of the Gondola (Adventure Peak learning area).

Patsy's.notes: Gentle green at the top of the Tram with lake views; 'most Tram riders take it down'.

Maggie's.notes: Longest green (1.8 km, 231 m vertical) off Powderbowl; mild but long enough to tire a first-week skier.

Maggie's Canyon.notes: South/west-facing gladed black on the California side; bakes and refreezes in spring.

Mineshaft.notes: Steepest blue at Heavenly by terrain tiles (46% sustained, 47% max): a within-color outlier.

Ponderosa.notes: Steep blue off Comet (45% sustained, 50% max).

Olympic Downhill.notes: 'Consistently medium-steep' blue cruiser; the resort's 5.5 mi 'longest run' includes Stagecoach below it. OSM segment alone: 2.1 km, 473 m vertical.
Olympic Downhill.source: skiheavenly experience checklist; dcski.com/articles/1677; terrain tiles

Big Dipper.notes: Wide 2 km groomer off Dipper Express; big-carve piste; crowded lift.

Little Dipper.notes: 'Mona Lisa' bump face under the Dipper lift; left ungroomed; sees more bump skiers than any run in the region.

Ellie's.notes: Long black off Sky Express (1.2 km, 380 m vertical); bumped most days but groomed at times - use the 'groomed today' condition when it is.
Ellie's.source: OSM mogul; firsttracksonline 2019-03 ('Ellie's: groomed skiing from the top')

Ellie's Swing.notes: Access swing into Ellie's; 19% sustained; rated black only by association.

Express Line.notes: Long bump line under Sky Express (1 km, 357 m vertical).
Express Line.source: OSM; terrain tiles; skitalk ('Sky had several long bump runs at a slightly milder pitch')

Sky Canyon.notes: Single-black mogul run off Sky Express on the California side (OSM: advanced, mogul, 43% sustained). NOT a Nevada-side chute.

Pinnacles.notes: California-side double-black glades between Sky Express and Tamarack (1.9 km, 619 m vertical, rock pinnacles). OSM centroid is 480 m from Sky Express - it is NOT in Killebrew. Gate status unverified; set gated=true if patrol gates it.

Backstroke.notes: Steep California-side woods near Tamarack (57% sustained).

Ski Ways Glades.notes: Low-to-moderate angle trees between Ridge Run and Ellie's; powder-day favorite.

Double Down.notes: California-side black near Canyon Express (NOT a Mott chute). Trees on skier's right were 'among the steepest pitches' skied in a 2008 report.

Outlaw.notes: Blue near the Galaxy chair on the Nevada side (22% sustained). NOT a Mott Canyon chute.

Ridge Run.notes: 'Most scenic trail in skiing'; moderate pitch from the top of Sky Express (3,038 m) with 433 m vertical.

Ridge Bowl.notes: Drop-in off Ridge Run; a steeper roll than its 35% sustained suggests.

California Trail.notes: Long lake-view blue connecting Tamarack to Sky Deck; best views on the mountain.

Skyline Trail.notes: The CA-NV ridge-top connector (13% sustained); long and flat-ish, hike above it reaches Milky Way Bowl.

North Bowl.notes: Steep, shaded Nevada-side bowl; 'outstanding storm skiing'; was being groomed in 2019 and 'mostly goes unskied'.

Nevada Woods.notes: East-facing trees on the side of North Bowl; sun-damaged after storms.

Milky Way Bowl.notes: Open steeps above Mott/Killebrew; foot access from the Skyline ridge; tracks out quickly; 59% sustained (30 deg).
Milky Way Bowl.source: worldsnowboardguide; ski.com heavenly-expert-skiing (via search snippet: 'open steeps of Milky Way Bowl ... accessed by foot only'); terrain tiles

Milky Way.notes: Black below Milky Way Bowl toward Dipper; 'large area to explore with low traffic'.

Mott Canyon Trail.notes: Rim access traverse from the top of the Mott Canyon chair (2,846 m) east along the canyon rim to the chute entrances (Widow Maker/Snake Eyes/Bill's tops at ~2,725-2,750 m). 19% sustained - it is black because of where it is, not how steep it is. Rating floored at 60 by the gated rule.
Mott Canyon Trail.source: OSM geometry; terrain tiles; ski.com (Mott is gate-accessed, 13 trails)

Widow Maker.notes: Mott Canyon chute 50 m from the chair line; choke near the bottom where a strong skier reported falling.

Snake Eyes.notes: Mott Canyon's choked chute with a usually-mandatory air; filled in only in big years (2017, 2019). 73% sustained (36 deg), 79% max.
Snake Eyes.source: firsttracksonline 2017-04 ('usually a mandatory air'), 2019-03 ('cliff filled in'); terrain tiles

Bill's.notes: North-facing Mott line; the usual first Mott run and the one most skied top-to-bottom; 75% sustained (37 deg) per tiles - steep but wider than the chutes.
Bill's.source: reddit r/Heavenly Mott first-timer (search snippet); skitalk 2022-23; firsttracksonline 2019-03; terrain tiles

Hully Gully.notes: Mott gully with a choke near the bottom under a cliff sign; the north side of it is the dividing line for good snow in Mott.

The \"Y\".notes: Mott chute that forks; 'the longer leg of the Y' is the common line; Bill's is to its right.

North 40.notes: Lower Mott line near the chair base.

Southern Comfort.notes: Mott Canyon tree line on the north wall.

Pinenuts.notes: Mott Canyon tree line 100 m from the chair.

Promised Land.notes: Short lower-Mott line near the chair base.

On Hold.notes: Mellower Mott tree line (39% sustained) on the north rim.

Rim Trail.notes: Killebrew exit traverse back to the Mott chair: short uphill, rocky stop-and-sidestep spots, very steep slopes below with the boundary rope hanging in the air. Take the high line.
Rim Trail.source: firsttracksonline 2008-01 MLK report; skitalk 2022-23 ('four stop-and-sidestep spots on the lower line')

Stateline.notes: Stateline Chute on the divide between Mott and Killebrew; skied from the top on the Mott side.

Pac-Man.notes: Killebrew line with a 77% max pitch.

Boundry Chutes.notes: Boundary chutes past Pipeline in Killebrew; the most north-facing terrain there; good snow and bump lines in the boundary trees.

Pipeline.notes: The classic Killebrew chute (76% sustained, 85% max); wind-affected snow common.

Outer Limits.notes: Entered from Mott through the highest gate into Killebrew; 66% sustained.

Bobs Boulevard.notes: Most east-facing run in Killebrew; top excellent, lower section turns to frozen corn.

Ramarah's.notes: Killebrew chute; 88% sustained (41 deg) per terrain tiles suggests rock bands.

The Fingers.notes: Killebrew finger chutes; steepest line at Heavenly by terrain tiles (91% sustained = 42 deg, 101% max).

Dipper Bowl.notes: Steep face with a firm, rough exit.

Comet.notes: Lake-view blue groomer; tree skiing off the side.

Orion.notes: Morning-sun blue off Dipper with the best coverage/surface and a great view at the top.

Galaxy Woods.notes: Easy in/out blue tree run off Galaxy (the 'beginner cruising' chair).

Upper Bonanza.notes: Blue tree run near Big Easy.

Powderbowl Woods.notes: Powder-day tree pick on the California side.

Waterfall.notes: Black bump pitch off Powderbowl; trees on the left side.

Boulder Chute.notes: Narrow black lane near North Bowl Express; mellow by grade (34%).

Enchanted Forest.notes: Kids' green through trees at California base; terrain-tile max pitch (43%) is a DEM artifact from a short bank and is suppressed by the ramp in the max-pitch term.

Pepi's.notes: Flat connector near North Bowl Express.

Advanced California Trail.notes: Gladed, ungroomed variant beside California Trail.
